claim: Impaired perivascular clearance contributes to CAA
interpretation_supported: Clearance failure is a biologically coherent contributor and may participate in feedback with vascular amyloid
not_established: That impaired outward flow is the initiating cause in sporadic human CAA or that MRI-visible PVS directly measure clearance
key_limitation: Human direction and flux are not directly measured
decisive_test: Longitudinal compartment-specific human transport measurement with regional temporal predictions

claim: Vascular physiological dysfunction precedes hemorrhage in CAA
interpretation_supported: Physiologic abnormalities plausibly occur before overt hemorrhagic lesions
not_established: A universal temporal sequence or sufficient accuracy for preclinical diagnosis
key_limitation: Sparse longitudinal sporadic CAA data
decisive_test: Repeated CVR, perfusion, permeability, and lesion imaging in initially hemorrhage-free participants

claim: BBB leakage is an early event in CAA vessel remodeling
interpretation_supported: Leakage is detectable at mildly amyloid-positive vessels and is present in remodeled vessels
not_established: That leakage initiates inflammation or rupture rather than reflecting concurrent injury
key_limitation: Cross-sectional inference from seven autopsy cases
decisive_test: Serial in vivo permeability followed by spatial whole-vessel pathology

claim: A strictly lobar hemorrhagic pattern increases the probability of CAA
interpretation_supported: Distribution is diagnostically informative in symptomatic populations when mimics and deep lesions are considered
not_established: That every lobar CMB is caused by CAA or that performance transfers unchanged to screening populations
key_limitation: Arteriolosclerosis can produce lobar CMBs and accuracy is spectrum-dependent
decisive_test: Large lesion-level MRI-pathology coregistration across symptomatic and community cohorts

claim: Severe centrum-semiovale PVS add information for CAA classification
interpretation_supported: CSO-PVS can improve sensitivity when combined with hemorrhagic features in Boston v2.0
not_established: That PVS are specific for CAA or directly quantify clearance
key_limitation: Incremental value varies by population and rating method
decisive_test: External pathology validation with arterial/venous mapping and prespecified thresholds

claim: The multispot WMH pattern adds information for CAA classification
interpretation_supported: The pattern can contribute to Boston v2.0 classification
not_established: That it is a strong standalone or pathology-specific CAA marker
key_limitation: Marginal incremental performance and limited direct validation
decisive_test: Large blinded MRI-pathology study against arteriolosclerosis and mixed-pathology controls

claim: Brain arteriolosclerosis is a heterogeneous family of vessel-wall changes
interpretation_supported: Regional, morphologic, etiologic, and measurement heterogeneity should be represented explicitly
not_established: A universally accepted molecular subtype system
key_limitation: Routine semiquantitative grading collapses different lesions
decisive_test: Multiregion molecular-spatial clustering with external replication

claim: Brain arteriolosclerosis contributes independently to cognitive impairment
interpretation_supported: Autopsy cohorts support an association after accounting for major co-pathologies
not_established: A single pathway, a precise individual-level effect, or reversibility
key_limitation: Residual confounding and measurement error in co-pathologies
decisive_test: Prospective pathology-linked biomarkers with domain-specific cognitive slopes

claim: Brain arteriolosclerosis is associated with hippocampal sclerosis/LATE-related pathology
interpretation_supported: Repeated autopsy data support a multiregional association
not_established: That arteriolosclerosis causes LATE-NC or hippocampal sclerosis
key_limitation: Cross-sectional autopsy data cannot determine temporal direction
decisive_test: Longitudinal vascular biomarkers followed by standardized LATE-NC pathology

claim: Nonhemorrhagic tissue injury contributes importantly to cognition in CAA
interpretation_supported: Diffusion, network, white-matter, and ischemic injury are plausible contributors beyond overt ICH
not_established: Their independent causal proportion after AD, LATE, and arteriolosclerosis are fully controlled
key_limitation: Co-pathology and mediation are incompletely measured
decisive_test: Longitudinal multimodal change models with AD/LATE biomarkers and incident lesions

claim: ARTS predicts pathology-linked arteriolosclerosis risk in older research cohorts
interpretation_supported: ARTS shows approximately 0.8 discrimination under short MRI-death intervals in development/testing cohorts
not_established: Clinical diagnostic accuracy in younger or representative populations, calibrated thresholds, or treatment responsiveness
key_limitation: Small pathology test set and incomplete external pathology replication
decisive_test: Locked multisite pathology validation with calibration and prespecified subgroup analysis

claim: ARTS is technically reproducible across repeat scans and scanners
interpretation_supported: Available studies report excellent repeatability and reproducibility
not_established: Etiologic specificity, clinical benefit, or biological change sensitivity
key_limitation: Key multisite report is currently a supplement abstract
decisive_test: Full protocol and results report with failure rates and version-locked container

claim: Higher ARTS scores are associated with cognitive decline and vascular outcomes
interpretation_supported: Multiple older-adult cohorts show associations with cognition and incident MCI, dementia, or stroke
not_established: That the associations are mediated specifically by arteriolosclerosis or improve decisions beyond established predictors
key_limitation: Predictor composition and residual confounding complicate causal interpretation
decisive_test: External incremental-value and decision-curve studies with pathology-informed mediation

claim: Inflammation participates in CAA vessel injury and ARIA
interpretation_supported: Inflammatory states are consistently linked to CAA-ri, ARIA, and late-stage vessel remodeling
not_established: A uniform harmful role at all stages or a simple inflammation-to-rupture sequence
key_limitation: Inflammation can be cause, response, or attempted clearance
decisive_test: Spatial immune-state comparison across stable clearance, edema, remodeling, and rupture

claim: CAA and Alzheimer disease share amyloid biology but remain compartmentally distinct diseases
interpretation_supported: Shared A-beta/APOE/age biology and frequent coexistence do not erase differences between vessel wall and parenchyma
not_established: A single unitary disease model
key_limitation: Compartment-specific temporal interactions remain uncertain
decisive_test: Joint molecular and longitudinal modeling of vascular and parenchymal amyloid

claim: Composite SVD scores summarize burden but do not identify etiology
interpretation_supported: Ordinal scores can stratify total visible burden and prognosis
not_established: Continuous severity, lesion mechanism, equal biological weighting, or one underlying disease
key_limitation: Thresholding and equal weights discard spatial and continuous information
decisive_test: External comparison with continuous latent spatial measures

claim: Boston v2.0 accuracy is strongly dependent on clinical context
interpretation_supported: Performance is materially higher in symptomatic tissue-selected cohorts than in community or nonhemorrhagic samples
not_established: Universal sensitivity or specificity across referral, memory, and screening settings
key_limitation: Available community validations remain selected autopsy-MRI subsets
decisive_test: Prospective multicentre validation across prespecified intended-use populations

claim: No fluid biomarker is currently sufficiently specific and validated for routine standalone CAA diagnosis
interpretation_supported: CSF and plasma measures remain research tools whose signals overlap with Alzheimer pathology
not_established: That fluid measures have no future role in multimodal or treatment-risk models
key_limitation: Few pathology-referenced studies and substantial AD overlap
decisive_test: Large pathology-anchored multimodal studies with prespecified cutoffs and external validation

claim: Cerebrovascular reactivity is a reproducible physiological correlate of SVD-related cognition and imaging progression, but is not etiologically specific
interpretation_supported: Multisite and longitudinal evidence supports CVR as a vascular-function marker related to cognition and later tissue injury
not_established: That CVR identifies CAA or arteriolosclerosis, adds clinical utility beyond conventional MRI, or is treatment-responsive
key_limitation: No pathology-specific reference standard and nontrivial gas-challenge implementation
decisive_test: Standardized multisite longitudinal CVR with pathology or validated etiologic reference, incremental-value analysis, and intervention responsiveness

claim: CAA-related inflammation has an ARIA-E-like clinical-radiological phenotype that differs from non-inflammatory CAA
interpretation_supported: Asymmetric parenchymal/sulcal FLAIR abnormalities and gyral swelling strongly characterize referred CAA-ri cohorts
not_established: That imaging alone always distinguishes CAA-ri from infection, neoplasm, PRES, vasculitis, or treatment-related ARIA
key_limitation: Retrospective specialist samples and incomplete biopsy verification
decisive_test: Prospective blinded multicentre accuracy study against adjudicated clinicopathologic diagnosis with alternative inflammatory controls

claim: Regional amyloid PET patterns may add differential information for CAA versus AD, but current evidence does not support standalone pathology-specific diagnosis
interpretation_supported: Group-level occipital-to-global and global retention differences are reproducible enough to justify prospective testing
not_established: A validated patient-level threshold that separates vascular from parenchymal amyloid across tracers and disease stages
key_limitation: Clinical reference standards, tracer heterogeneity, and extensive AD co-pathology
decisive_test: Prospective multi-tracer PET-to-autopsy study with prespecified regional thresholds and mixed-pathology modeling

claim: Spontaneous CAA-related inflammation and treatment-related ARIA share vascular-amyloid, permeability, and inflammatory features but are not interchangeable entities
interpretation_supported: The overlap is a productive mechanistic analogy that informs detection and monitoring
not_established: That the conditions have identical initiating events, natural history, risk factors, or optimal treatment
key_limitation: Mechanistic evidence is partly inferential and clinical data on severe ARIA predictors remain limited
decisive_test: Harmonized longitudinal imaging, fluid, genetic, and pathology comparison of spontaneous CAA-ri and therapy-associated ARIA

claim: Hereditary CAA is a powerful temporal and mechanistic model but does not automatically transport to sporadic late-life CAA
interpretation_supported: Monogenic disease can clarify sequence and penetrance under a defined causal lesion
not_established: That effect sizes, ages, co-pathology, or treatment response match sporadic disease
key_limitation: Rare variants and younger, highly selected families differ from typical late-life multimorbidity
decisive_test: Parallel harmonized longitudinal phenotyping of hereditary and sporadic CAA with shared biomarkers and explicit transport models

claim: Blood biomarkers can index components of vascular injury but currently lack standalone specificity for CAA or brain arteriolosclerosis
interpretation_supported: Endothelial, inflammatory, pericyte, and injury markers can support mechanistic stratification and multimodal models
not_established: A validated single blood test for either target vessel pathology
key_limitation: Construct overlap, assay heterogeneity, confounding, and few pathology-linked cohorts
decisive_test: Blinded multisite pathology-linked plasma study with prespecified assays, competing pathologies, and incremental-value analysis
